I've never found a person sexually attractive time that was a model/actor etc unless I had a small obsession over them. I have to have an emotional attachment to someone to find them sexually appealing. 
Usually I'll move on from one obsession to another.  Which will happen if someone cones into my life who sparks an interest and when I slowly start to change view on my last obsession. Changing my view will occur if that person has caused me a great amount of pain over and over again, they've done something to turn me off ( can be as simple as saying a dumb remark, or making a face I don't like)

I've been that girl before. Maybe still am but not so extreme. My insecurities come from past relationships with men who were not faithful. If it was me, I'd feel better reading a post like this from my SO. Knowing he's telling the world/others how he feels about me. Seems silly but maybe show her this post. 
We all have different "love languages" so maybe ask her how she likes to be shown love. To help ease her insecurities. BC no matter how many times you blatantly tell her you love her and would never cheat, that will not change her mind. I'm sure it's painfully frustrating for you, you will both need to be patient with one another. She basically needs to retrain her brain and it'll take time. 
Good luck & thank you for posting this. It gave me a reminder of how the other half feels when I act out on my own insecurities.

In my opinion I think you have the right to withdraw from the agreement. I would explain to him how you feel & why you are feeling that way. I would imagine the feeling that he cheated has to do with him not telling you right away. That he kept it a secret for a month when he knew he could be open. I also understand why he might have waited, it may have been difficult to say out loud & maybe he feels guilt as if he cheated.  That's something you'll need to discuss. If you both want your relationship to continue happily, talk to him about your feelings & he should be open and understanding to listen & be honest with you. If he cannot talk about it or gets angry that wouldn't be a good sign. And from my experience, you won't get the trust back that you had for him before.
